sources.entry: Other Awesome lists: Awesome Big Data, Awesome Public Datasets

summary.one_liner: A curated, topic-organized list of links to public datasets across many fields, from agriculture and biology to economics, climate, and cybersecurity.
summary.what_it_does: This is an "awesome" list: a README of links to public data sources grouped by topic (for example Agriculture, Biology, Chemistry, Climate+Weather, ComplexNetworks, ComputerNetworks, CyberSecurity, DataChallenges, EarthScience, Economics, Education, Energy, Entertainment). Each entry gives a short description of the dataset and a link to its source, with a "Meta" link on most entries. The README states that most listed datasets are free but some are not. It also marks entries with OK or FIXME icons to show link status. The README says it is auto-generated by apd-core and asks readers not to edit it directly. The provided excerpt is truncated, so later categories were not visible.
use_cases: find public datasets for a research project
locate open data on climate and weather
find economic and trade statistics sources
find datasets for machine learning practice or data challenges
look up energy and electricity load data
notable: Organized into dozens of topic categories, from agriculture to entertainment
Each entry includes a short description and a source link, with Meta links
Entries carry OK or FIXME status icons marking link health
Lists the awesome-selfhosted and sindresorhus awesome lists as related resources
Community contribution channel through a Slack and a separate contribution process
caveats: Many datasets are not free, as the README notes
Entries marked FIXME indicate links that need repair
The README says it is auto-generated, so direct edits are discouraged
